open_items: register immutable controlled records with exact type, status, revision, configuration, path, and SHA-256 bindings
bind the determined DAL B software level to the applicable controlled certification basis when that basis is supplied
run the resolver with --require-resolved before any release-candidate or authority-candidate transition
non_claims: Resolution verifies registered identity, applicability, revision, configuration, status, and bytes; it does not validate the decision's technical or legal sufficiency.
A resolved record does not by itself establish certification credit, tool qualification, organizational independence, release approval, or authority acceptance.
